{{Quote|What's going on here?''"<br />"''I don't know&mdash;okay, who's got someone mad at them? Raise your hands.''" [All the crew members present raise their hands.]''<nowiki></nowiki>|A freighter's captain and another crew member, upon being ambushed by bounty hunters on Fether|<ref name="MT" />|trans=1}}
'''Fether''' was a [[Agriworld/Legends|farming world]] located on the [[Solenbaran Merchant Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] hosted a population of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ocsin]] and was the site of a small [[Unidentified town (Fether)|spaceport town]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified bounty hunter group|group]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Battle on Fether|ambushed]] the crew of a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in the streets of the [[City/Legends|town]] due to the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Unidentified smuggler (Fether)|captain]] owing [[Currency/Legends|money]] to the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters']] employer. The crew was subsequently chased to its ship and then left Fether.

==Description==
Fether was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="MT" /> located in the [[Fether system/Legends|Fether system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Solenbaran Merchant Route]] linked the planet to the [[Deltooine system/Legends|Deltooine]] and [[Ocsin system/Legends|Ocsin systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Issagra system/Legends|Issagra system]] lay at a distance of twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel away from Fether.<ref name="MT" />

==History==
{{Dialogue|Bounty hunter|Okay, you slimy smuggler. You can come out now. We've been sent to get the money you owe on the ship.|Freighter's crew member|Bounty hunters&mdash;we've got bounty hunters after us?|Another crew member|How many payments have you missed on your ship?|Freighter's captain|A&hellip; few.|attr=A freighter's crew learns why it is being attacked on Fether|src=<ref name="MT" />}}
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] delivered a shipment of [[Gervi fruit]] to Fether. Following the delivery, the freighter's crew wandered through the streets of a local [[Unidentified town (Fether)|town]]. When the crew members were in the center of the [[City/Legends|town]], about a block away from their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], a [[Unidentified bounty hunter group|group]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Battle on Fether|ambushed]] them, opening [[Lightfight|blasterfire]] on them. The [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] had been hired by a [[Loan shark|loanshark]] to capture the freighter's [[Unidentified smuggler (Fether)|smuggler captain]] and the rest of the crew due to the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] having missed out on loan [[Currency/Legends|payments]] for the ship.<ref name="MT" />

{{RPG|"[[Money Troubles]]"}}
The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters proceeded to chase the freighter's crew through the streets of the town. During the battle, the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] arrived at the scene of the fighting. In addition, one of the crew members rescued a small [[Youngling/Legends|child]] who had wandered into the street from getting accidentally injured, and the crew also evaded a vehicle that had veered out of control as a result of being hit by a stray [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|bolt]]. Eventually, the freighter's crew reached its ship and left the planet, engaging the bounty hunters' modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the ''[[Heroc's Slayer]]'', before leaving for the Issagra [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="MT" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
A minor,<ref name="TEA" /> isolated<ref name="MT" /> [[Agriworld/Legends|farming world]], Fether was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a substantial population of immigrated [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ocsin]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
A small [[Farm/Legends|farm]] town that featured a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was located on Fether. The town's streets were dusty and filled with crates as well as [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|vehicles]], such as [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="MT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fether was introduced in "[[Money Troubles]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure designed for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and included in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|second edition]] of the game's rulebook. The book was authored by [[Bill Smith]] and published in [[1992]]. This article assumes the adventure plays out as described.<ref name="MT" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Fether in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />

Despite the adventure being set during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="MT" /> the entry for the ''Heroc's Slayer'' in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' erroneously claims that the group of individuals the freighter pursued to the Issagra system,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|36|''Heroc's Slayer''}}</ref> as depicted in "Money Troubles,"<ref name="MT" /> was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="CSWE" /> the predecessor of the New Republic.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
